items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I made an album with him and Kenny

ctx.x: He was one of those who came to the house in ’46 when I had just bought the bass. Ray Brown, John Lewis, Milt Jackson and I’m not sure if it was Kenny, [but] I think it was Kenny too at that time.
So you met the future members of MJQ in your house in Philly?
